items.title: If I marry my girlfriend, 67, will she lose her Supplemental Security Income and divorced spouse benefits?
items.description: “She has been living with me for four years.”

items.title: Traders are using options to chase a runaway rebound in stocks, pushing the market even higher
items.description: Stocks have shot higher over the past four trading sessions, and investors who are worried about missing out are piling into bullish options bets just to try to keep up.

items.title: ‘We have always been civil’: My sister refuses to replace me as executor. Can I step down before she dies?
items.description: “I haven’t seen my sister since our mother’s funeral more than 20 years ago.”

items.title: So what’s the plan to bring down inflation? The new Fed chair and his White House allies say you shouldn’t ask.
items.description: Critics say Kevin Warsh’s determination to cool prices gains isn’t sufficient.

items.title: I got two email invitations from friends. Is this a phishing scam — or am I suddenly popular?
items.description: “I was surprised — and flattered — to find myself on the guest list.”

items.title: ‘My head hit the driver’s window’: A teenager T-boned our car. Will Medicare pay my hospital bills?
items.description: “My car was nearly 20 years old, and I only carried liability and uninsured motorist coverage, not collision coverage.”

items.title: Oil prices dive on hopes that a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz will be made soon
items.description: Oil prices turned sharply lower on Tuesday after a Qatari official talked about a potential short-term deal between the U.S. and Iran.

items.title: McDonald’s admits its value meals have become too confusing
items.description: The fast-food chain said too many promotions at once led to confusion for staff and customers alike.
